---
title: "Step 10: Install towers on baseplates"
description: Feed each cluster's FFC through the base plate and screw the tower to the base plate.
sidebar:
  order: 11
---

1. Take a cluster and tower assembly. Feed the cluster's FFC through the matching hole in the base plate.
2. Put an M3x6 mm screw through the tower base and into the square nut in the base plate slot.
3. Tighten it enough to hold the tower. You'll move the towers later to fit your hand ([Step 18](/build/step-18-adjust-fit/)), so don't tighten them hard.

![Towers and clusters on a base plate. A line points to where a cluster's FFC passes through the base plate.](../../../assets/build/towers-on-baseplate.webp)

If you have a TrackPoint, trackball or touchpad, install it next: see [Steps 10a to 10c](/build/step-10-pointing-devices/).
